delete_link_confirm: Delete the link from the topology and from all maps?
delete_map_confirm: Delete map "{name}"? It will no longer be shown, and references to it in other maps are removed. Inventory hosts and links are kept, and the map record stays in maps.yaml.
delete_selection_confirm_one: Delete {count} host from the inventory and its links/references in all maps{objects}? Hosts: {list}.
delete_selection_confirm_other: Delete {count} hosts from the inventory and their links/references in all maps{objects}? Hosts: {list}.
partial_delete_one: {count} host already removed. Deletion stopped; check the remaining selection before trying again.
partial_delete_other: {count} hosts already removed. Deletion stopped; check the remaining selection before trying again.
reload_confirm: Discard unsaved local changes and load the current version from the server?
wait_save_before_continuing: Wait for the map to save or resolve the conflict before continuing.
wait_save_before_leaving: Wait for the map to save or resolve the failure before leaving.
